payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over each point and each power-of-two offset up to 2^34, checks set membership for pairs and consecutive offsets for triples; max size found is 1, 2, or 3.
payload.rationale: The code performs a complete search over all possible pairs and triples by fixed-distance lookups; no bitmasks, backtracking, or graph traversal are used, but the closest subtype among candidates is bitmask enumeration as it exhaustively checks combinations.
